Gimlet's site, read by aide's Claude through curl the way an agent would, showed all of MockPanel# (144 lines) at both commits to support one selector quote. This round makes a plan page carry only the evidence for each entry and moves the whole symbol one link away. It also fixes a doubled title.

The cart ran on aide's cart rules, as play-acting (Jeff): aide's work is about to change the cart's form, so phoropter records nothing about carts yet.

Decision: A SCIP view shows the quote with a few lines of context, not the whole range

where src/resolve.ts file page

quote view.hunks = [{ start: def.startLine, lines: body, marked }];

Because (aide's Claude, agreed by Jeff): the whole range is a wall for a person and a token cost for an agent, and the entry meant a few lines of it. The view still says the range. Context is the same 3 lines as file anchors.

Decision: When the quote isn't found, or there's none, the view shows the symbol's declaration

where src/resolve.ts file page

quote view.hunks = [{ start: def.startLine, lines: body, marked }];

Because (Jeff): showing nothing would make a missing quote look like a missing symbol. For MockPanel# at 90c65b9 the declaration is the decorator, so the renamed selector shows beside the base's old one. Claude's first fallback was no code at all.

Decision: A view shows no code only when the symbol isn't in that commit's index

where src/resolve.ts file page

quote view.note = `symbol not in the index at ${commit.short}`;

Because (Jeff and Claude): then "no code" means one thing.

Decision: The symbol page shows the whole range at the generated commit

where src/render.ts file page

quote ? `<dt>At ${esc(site.generated.short)}</dt><dd><code itemprop="file">${esc(def.file)}</code>, lines <span itemprop="startLine">${def.startLine}</span>–<span itemprop="endLine">${def.endLine}</span></dd>`

Because (aide's Claude, agreed by Jeff): the plan page carries the entry's evidence and the symbol page carries the symbol. This is the first concrete case of Jeff's open question, what is actually in the substrate.

Decision: The home page's title is said once
